day_context.tournament_summary: A week in, Group A turns on a rematch: Mexico and Korea Republic, who last met in the 2018 group stage in Russia, renew it at Estadio Akron in Guadalajara.
context_notes: Mexico vs Korea Republic at Estadio Akron, Guadalajara — a rematch of their 2018 World Cup group-stage meeting (Mexico won 2–1).
Both are in Group A alongside South Africa and Czechia.

goals.note: (Chicharito's 50th for Mexico, slid in by Lozano)

narrative_beats: Mexico beat Korea Republic 2–1 in Rostov — Carlos Vela from the spot, then Chicharito's 50th international goal, threaded through by Hirving Lozano.
Son Heung-min answered with a long-range stoppage-time strike, but it was already too late.
The win, on the back of Mexico's shock defeat of holders Germany, put El Tri on the brink of the last 16.
Days later Korea repaid the group: they beat Germany 2–0 and knocked the champions out — and Mexican fans carried Korean supporters on their shoulders, hailing them as 'hermanos'.

back_story.ledger: Mexico and Korea Republic last met at the 2018 World Cup — a 2–1 Mexico win in the Russian group stage that, days later, became the night Korea sent Germany home and Mexico called them brothers. They are drawn together again in Group A, and meet today at the Akron.
